### T-127 — Implement the planned adapter idle handling

> _2026-09-22 · core/blong-gogo · open_

Planned feature, not a defect (reworded from S20 at the maintainer request: keep the names, present
them as future work). patterns/handler.md documents idleSend, idleReceive and drainSend as the
intended lifecycle hooks for keep-alive and idle handling, and the page now marks them as planned
rather than current while saying which configuration is already written for them. To implement:
dispatch the three hooks from the adapter loop (idle after a configured quiet period on the send and
the receive side, drain when the send queue empties), read the idleSend and idleReceive
configuration keys that concepts/adapter.md:35, patterns/adapter.md and
test/framework/ctp/adapter/payshield.ts:10 already set, and give AdapterBase.drain, which is
subscribed to the drain event, real behaviour.

### T-142 — blong-gogo graceful shutdown test fails on its own

> _2026-09-24 · core/blong-gogo · open_

src/graceful-shutdown.spawn.test.ts fails with the CLI exiting 143 rather than 0, both in a full run
and when run alone, while the rest of the suite is green. Nothing in this session touched the CLI or
its shutdown path, so it looks pre-existing and environment-dependent: check whether the marker file
is flushed before the signal is delivered, and whether a loaded machine is enough to lose the race,
before changing the code.
